OVERVIEW: Shows
when your Appgate
SDP session
expires.

Works it out from
Appgate's driver
logs, which any
user can read. No
root, no network.
Unofficial and not
affiliated with
Appgate.

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1
within the warn
window, 2 expired
or not signed in, 3
logs unreadable or
in a format
gatekeepr doesn't
know.

USAGE: gatekeepr <subcommand>

OPTIONS:
  --version
  -h, --help

SUBCOMMANDS:
  status (default)
  history

  See 'gatekeepr help <subcommand>' for detailed help.
-- stderr --
